title: H2 Stalker Familiarization at MCAGCC
description: U.S. Marines with 3rd and 7th Marine Regiment, 1st Marine Division, conduct flight operations with a H2 Stalker during a training and familiarization exercise at check point 35, Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center, Twentynine Palms, California, Oct 22, 2026. The H2 Stalker is powered by a hydrogen fuel cell which extends the flight time, reduces the thermal signature and lowers negative environmental impacts. The exercise provides operators with hands-on experience and increased familiarity with the system's flight capabilities. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Pvt. Jonathan Cardona)
